description: This file contains CSS styles and variables for theming and layout of the interactive Tic Tac Toe game interface.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main styling for the application, handling overall layout and theme.

classes.name: game-title
classes.description: Styles for the game title display, including font size and color.

classes.name: status
classes.description: Styles for displaying the game's status with appropriate font size and color.

classes.name: board
classes.description: Styles for the game board, defining grid layout and appearance.

classes.name: square
classes.description: Styles for individual squares in the Tic Tac Toe game.

classes.name: reset-button
classes.description: Styles for the button that resets the game.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the button that toggles between light and dark themes.
